slides.texte_overlay:
5 tiny rules that changed
how i spend my free time

one hobby with my hands

i always have one thing i'm making with my hands: a puzzle, a plant, a drawing. it gives my free time a slow, satisfying focus that no screen has ever given me.

outside every day

i spend at least thirty minutes outside every single day, whatever the weather. my mood on long grey weeks changed completely once i finally stopped skipping it.

no screens at meals

i never eat in front of a screen, even when i'm alone. meals became small calm breaks in my day instead of more time spent half watching something i'd forget.

learn first, then relax

i do five minutes of learning before i let myself relax: a painting, a myth, a planet. starting my free time with something real makes the rest feel earned.
slides.texte_sophia:

i do one 5 minute lesson in the Sophia app before i let myself relax: a painting, a myth, a planet. starting my free time with something real makes the rest feel earned.

slides.texte_overlay:
one call a week

i call one friend or family member every week instead of only texting. a real voice for twenty minutes keeps people closer than a hundred messages ever did.
